_comment: OpenSSF Best Practices answers for passing and silver, read from this file by bestpractices.dev (RepoJsonDetective). Every claim here must stay true: the test count is checked by scripts/check-doc-claims.mjs, and the rest is evidence a reader can verify from this repository. Gold is not answered here: three of its criteria (bus_factor, contributors_unassociated, two_person_review) need a second maintainer. See docs/ROADMAP.md.
description_good_justification: README describes the problem and the solution in the opening paragraphs, in user-facing language: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#readme
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states that every change lands through a pull request, with the required standard and the test policy: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md — required coding standard, audit cycle, and the testing policy.
documentation_basics_justification: README documents what the software is, how to install it, the 17 MCP tools and the 20 pipeline steps: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#readme. Worked examples: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/docs/EXAMPLES.md
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the MCP tool surface: all 17 tools with inputs and outputs are documented at https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#the-mcp-tools, and the wire contract at https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#what-an-agent-can-ask-it
sites_https_justification: Project site and repository are GitHub, HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests: searchable, each message and topic addressable by URL, open to new participants, no proprietary client needed. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/issues
english_justification: All documentation, issues and commit messages are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: releases through v0.6.1 and commits within the last day. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change lands through a PR on main; interim work is visible as PR branches. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/pulls?q=is%3Apr
version_tags_justification: Each release is a git tag: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md, Keep a Changelog format, per release: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No run-time vulnerability with a CVE assignment has been fixed in any release to date. Where known-vulnerable dependencies were removed the release notes say so: CHANGELOG.md records the dependency advisory backlog going from 39 to 0 with an empty audit ignore list. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_responses_justification: Every bug report in the tracker was acknowledged and closed, most within hours (for example issues #28, #29, #33, #34 and #36, all opened and closed on 2026-07-24 to 2026-07-26). No issue is currently open. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests use the same tracker and the same response pattern: every one raised so far was answered and resolved, none is open. https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: Issues and PRs are public and permanently archived: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents the process and the SLA: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private GitHub Security Advisories are enabled; SECURITY.md links the private channel: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. The process and the response commitment are documented at https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
build_justification: pnpm build (TypeScript project references across 10 packages): https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/package.json
build_common_tools_justification: pnpm + tsc, both standard in the ecosystem.
build_floss_tools_justification: pnpm, TypeScript, vitest and esbuild are all FLOSS.
test_justification: vitest suite, 1504 tests across 99 test files, run on Node 20 and 22 in CI: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_invocation_justification: pnpm test — single documented command, stated in README and CONTRIBUTING.
test_most_justification: 1504 tests covering every package's public surface. Statement coverage is a gate rather than a report: `pnpm test:coverage` exits non-zero below 80% (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/vitest.config.ts).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs build, tests on Node 20 and 22, CodeQL, and a smoke test that starts the shipped artifact, on every push and PR: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the policy that behaviour-changing PRs must ship tests: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing
tests_are_added_justification: Enforced in review; recent examples: property-based tests added with the validation work, and a regression smoke test added with the bundle fix.
warnings_justification: TypeScript strict mode is on for every package (tsconfig.base.json), and lint runs tsc --noEmit.
warnings_fixed_justification: The build fails on any TypeScript error; CI blocks merge on it.
warnings_strict_justification: strict: true for every package in https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/tsconfig.base.json; the build fails on any error.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least-privilege and validate-at-the-boundary explicitly; see SECURITY.md and the layering rules in the coding standard.
know_common_errors_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and the injection/traversal classes it reports are fixed at the root cause rather than guarded; see the CHANGELOG entries for the file-access-to-http and ReDoS fixes.
crypto_published_justification: The software implements no cryptography of its own.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The software implements and calls no cryptography.
crypto_pfs_justification: No network protocol of its own; the server speaks stdio.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software stores no user passwords.
crypto_random_justification: No security-relevant random values are generated. The one RNG (mulberry32, in bootstrap CIs) is deliberately deterministic for reproducibility and is not security-relevant.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed over HTTPS from GitHub; releases carry a SHA-256 companion and a Sigstore build-provenance attestation.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release artifacts are attested with Sigstore and their checksum is verified in the pipeline: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supply-chain-assurance
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched vulnerabilities; pnpm audit reports zero advisories with an empty ignore list.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: The dependency advisory backlog was taken from 39 to 0, including one critical.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repository. GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (javascript-typescript) on every push and PR plus a weekly schedule: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-and-quality on every push and PR plus weekly: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml — 0 open alerts.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Zero open CodeQL alerts on main.
static_analysis_often_justification: Every push and pull request, plus a weekly scheduled run.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based testing with fast-check (packages/validation) generates varied inputs to look for violations of stated invariants, and the anti-ReDoS harness executes the shipped regexes against generated inputs of growing size and asserts on the measured growth ratio (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/packages/validation/src/__tests__/regex-hardening.perf.ts). Both run in CI on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TypeScript on Node is memory-safe; there is no unsafe/unmanaged code for a memory-safety dynamic analyser to target. Property-based testing over generated input covers the equivalent ground.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The suite runs with the runtime schema validation (Zod) active at every boundary, so a malformed state or action fails loudly during testing rather than being coerced, and the property-based tests assert their invariants on every generated case.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No vulnerability has been discovered by the property-based or growth-ratio analysis. A failure in either fails CI and blocks the merge, so a finding cannot sit unfixed.
achieve_passing_justification: All passing criteria are recorded as Met/N-A on this project.
dco_justification: The project has no DCO or CLA requirement today. All non-trivial code is written by the sole maintainer, who owns the copyright and licenses it under MIT (see the authorship statement in https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#license). A DCO sign-off requirement is the intended mechanism if outside contributors start submitting non-trivial changes.
governance_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md — who decides, how, and how decisions are recorded.
roles_responsibilities_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities — maintainer, contributor, security reporter. States plainly that there is currently one maintainer.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity-of-access — what survives if the maintainer stops (public MIT code, git tags, Sigstore-verifiable releases) and what is genuinely single-owner.
bus_factor_justification: The project has one maintainer, so the bus factor is 1. This is stated plainly rather than papered over: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md documents who decides, what happens to the project if the maintainer stops, and the MIT terms that let anyone fork and continue.
documentation_roadmap_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md states what the project intends to do for the next year (calibration and closed loops, OpenSSF gold as far as one maintainer can take it, distribution, and closing the post-specs loop's open questions) and an explicit section on what it will not do. Linked from the README.
documentation_architecture_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#architecture — layer diagram and the dependency rule, plus the package tree.
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md and https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE-CASE.md — threat model, supply-chain guarantees, and the security argument with its limits.
documentation_quick_start_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#getting-started — install and first run in under ten lines.
documentation_current_justification: Docs are corrected in the same PR as the change, and the advertised test count is machine-checked rather than hand-maintained: scripts/check-doc-claims.mjs reads the count from vitest's own reporter and fails the build on drift. It runs on every push and pull request (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) and again at release.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The project results have no graphical user interface: the software is an MCP server speaking stdio, and its output is plain Markdown and JSON that the consuming host renders. The project site is GitHub, and the documentation is Markdown with text alternatives on the images.
internationalization_justification: The server's own user-facing strings (banners, prompts, error messages) are English literals and are not externalized for localization. The PRD content itself is produced by the calling host in whatever language the user drives it in, so it is unaffected. Externalizing the server's strings has not been done.
sites_password_security_justification: The project operates no website that accepts passwords; the repository is hosted on GitHub.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Actively maintained: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/commits/main and releases through v0.6.1.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md — reporters are credited in the advisory unless they decline.
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#response-sla — documented SLA and disclosure timeline; private advisories enabled.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: TypeScript strict mode across every package (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/tsconfig.base.json) and lint runs tsc --noEmit; CI blocks merge on any error.
build_standard_variables_justification: Standard pnpm/tsc conventions; no bespoke build variables.
build_preserve_debug_justification: tsconfig.base.json sets declaration, declarationMap and sourceMap to true, so the build preserves debugging information: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/tsconfig.base.json. Note that the single-file esbuild bundle shipped inside the .mcpb is not built with a source map; the per-package build output that developers debug against is.
build_non_recursive_justification: pnpm -r drives per-package tsc via TypeScript project references; no recursive make.
build_repeatable_justification: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile then pnpm build; the lockfile is committed and CI installs from it.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec#getting-started — claude plugin install, or the .mcpb bundle.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Install honours the host's standard locations; no bespoke prefix handling.
external_dependencies_justification: Declared in package.json per package and locked in pnpm-lock.yaml; the shipped bundle's runtime deps are in https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/mcp-server/package.json with a committed lockfile.
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml — npm and github-actions, weekly; Dependabot security updates and alerts enabled.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: No vendored or forked dependencies; everything is a normal versioned package, updated via Dependabot.
interfaces_current_justification: The stack targets currently supported runtimes (Node 20 and 22, both in the CI matrix) and current major versions of its toolchain (TypeScript 7, vitest, esbuild, pnpm). `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` runs in CI with an empty ignore list, and no deprecated or obsolete API is relied on.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: CI runs the full suite on Node 20 and 22, a growth/anti-ReDoS suite, and a smoke test that starts the shipped .mcpb and speaks MCP to it: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: Every bug fixed carries a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code — the policy is stated in CONTRIBUTING.md#testing and enforced in review.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: 81.14% statement coverage, enforced as a GATE: pnpm test:coverage exits non-zero below 80% (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/vitest.config.ts). Verified to bite — raising the threshold produces "ERROR: Coverage for statements does not meet global threshold" and exit 1.
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#testing — behaviour-changing PRs must ship tests in the same PR, with the consequence stated.
implement_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE-CASE.md — least privilege, validate at the trust boundary, and failure modes that emit a signal rather than failing silently.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The software implements and configures no cryptography of its own.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No cryptographic credentials are stored or used.
crypto_used_network_justification: The software performs no network communication. The server speaks MCP over stdio and opens no socket; this is stated in SECURITY.md and verified by the release smoke test that starts the shipped artifact.
crypto_tls12_justification: The software does not use TLS; it has no network surface of its own.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The server makes no outbound TLS connections; it speaks stdio.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: No cryptographic verification of private information is performed.
signed_releases_justification: Every release carries a Sigstore build-provenance attestation and a published SHA-256, verified in the pipeline: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supply-chain-assurance
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are annotated but not cryptographically signed (`git tag -v v0.6.1` reports no signature). Release artifacts are covered instead: each carries a SHA-256 companion and a Sigstore build-provenance attestation generated in the release workflow. See https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supply-chain-assurance
input_validation_justification: All input is treated as untrusted — it is LLM-generated text. Validation is the product's core: deterministic Hard Output Rules plus property-based tests over generated input (https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/packages/validation/src/__tests__/validate-section.properties.test.ts).
hardening_justification: This criterion counts mechanisms such as HTTP response headers or compiler hardening flags, and explicitly excludes least privilege. The software is a Node process speaking stdio: it serves no HTTP surface for a Content Security Policy to apply to, and Node offers no equivalent of -fstack-protector to enable. The protections it does use (schema validation at every boundary, no eval or dynamic code construction anywhere in the source, no network listener) are real but are not what this criterion measures, so it is reported as unmet rather than argued into a pass.
assurance_case_justification: https://github.com/cdeust/ai-architect-mcp-spec/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE-CASE.md — four claims, the evidence under each, and the limit of each, closing with what it does NOT claim.
